Checklist Item: Semantic-to-div ratio above threshold; pages with >70% generic containers (div/span) flagged
Comments: SPA markup is dominated by generic div/span wrappers around Spectrum Text/Card rather than native landmarks. No semantic-ratio tooling or CI gate exists.

Checklist Item: Correct heading hierarchy maintained
Comments: No native h1-h6 in app/. Page titles use Spectrum Text with heading font (PageHeader), so the document outline is not a heading hierarchy.

Checklist Item: Single h1 per page where applicable
Comments: No page-level h1. PageHeader renders title as Text, not h1. FileUpload Heading is a DropZone slot, not a page h1.

Checklist Item: DOM source order matches visual tab order; no positive tabindex values; CSS order/flex-direction does not contradict DOM sequence
Comments: No positive tabindex. No CSS order or flex-direction:row-reverse found that would invert visual vs DOM/tab order.

Checklist Item: Page content hierarchy intact: headings and body text present in raw HTML source; critical content not injected solely via JavaScript; no content exclusively hidden via inline style or JS-only class toggling
Comments: index.html only contains #root. All product copy, headings, and workflow content are injected by React after JS runs.

Checklist Item: Avoid excessive DOM depth
Comments: No DOM-depth budget or static check. Nested layout (MainLayout + sidebars + cards + dialogs) is typical SPA depth without a gate.

Checklist Item: Radio/checkbox groups wrapped in fieldset with legend; forms with 3+ related inputs have grouping
Comments: No fieldset/legend. RadioGroup is used in 3 places; checkbox clusters (ConfiguredPackageCard, ReviewApprove, ProductDetails) are not wrapped in CheckboxGroup/fieldset.

Checklist Item: All inputs have associated labels
Comments: 1 unlabeled native input: AgentPanel chat field has placeholder only (no label/aria-label). Native textarea in EditRegenPanel does have aria-label.

Checklist Item: Placeholder not used as label
Comments: AgentPanel input uses placeholder as the only name. ComboBox/SearchField/TextField generally pair placeholder with label or aria-label.

Checklist Item: Error messages programmatically associated with inputs via aria-describedby or aria-errormessage; error containers use role='alert' or aria-live='assertive'; error text is non-empty and >10 characters
Comments: No aria-describedby, aria-errormessage, isInvalid, errorMessage, role=alert, or aria-live on form fields. SaveCustomPackageDialog TextField is isRequired without error association.

Checklist Item: Avoid inline styles
Comments: 80+ inline style={{}} and UNSAFE_style usages across pages (ReviewApprove, EditRegenPanel, ProductDetails, TemplatePreview, GenerateAsset).

Checklist Item: Accessible names for interactive elements
Comments: Icon-only ActionButtons use aria-label (Header, Filter, Close). Visible-text Buttons/native buttons provide names. Agent unlabeled input is scored under labels.

Checklist Item: Images with role='presentation' or aria-hidden='true' have empty alt; standalone without adjacent text and without alt flagged; hero/banner images verified to have non-empty alt >10 chars; in decorative containers verified to have empty alt or role='presentation'
Comments: Meaningful product/package thumbnails use alt="" while adjacent titles exist (ProjectCard, ConfiguredPackageCard, OutputPackageCard). Decorative regen icon empty-alt is OK.

Checklist Item: Alt text is not a filename or path; not generic (image/photo/icon/picture/graphic/banner/logo without qualifier); between 5-125 characters; does not duplicate adjacent text content; does not begin with 'image of'/'picture of'/'photo of'; alt on linked images describes destination
Comments: 8+ content images use empty alt. HP logo alt is 2 chars (HP). Some images have good alts (carousel, GenerateAsset Image). No 5-125 char enforcement.

Checklist Item: Tables use thead and tbody
Comments: Data tables use Spectrum TableView with TableHeader/TableBody (ProductDetails, VariantImagesDialog, ReportIssueDialog).

Checklist Item: Table headers use th
Comments: TableView Column provides header cells (equivalent of th) with isRowHeader on Codename.

Checklist Item: Lists use ul or ol correctly
Comments: No native ul/ol. ProjectCardGrid uses div role=list/listitem instead of ul/ol.

Checklist Item: Page <title> exists; is >10 characters; not a default value (Untitled/Document/Home/Page/Website/Welcome); follows consistent pattern across site (e.g. 'Page - Site' or 'Page | Site' separator detected)
Comments: index.html title is mAIstro (7 chars, below 10). Not Untitled, but no Page | Site pattern and SPA does not update title per route.

Checklist Item: Meta viewport configured correctly
Comments: meta viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1 with no user-scalable=no or maximum-scale.

Checklist Item: No duplicate IDs
Comments: No duplicate HTML ids in authored markup. Collection ids (select, codename) live inside S2 TableView scope. Only static id is root.

Checklist Item: No invalid HTML nesting
Comments: No html-validate/vnu in CI. Custom tab buttons nest Text; no automated nesting check. 0 validator findings because no validator is run.

Checklist Item: HTML validates without errors
Comments: No HTML validator in npm scripts. SPA templates are not statically validated.

Checklist Item: ARIA roles do not duplicate native semantics
Comments: No native elements with redundant matching roles (no button role=button). Custom tabs use button+role=tab which is the ARIA tabs pattern.

Checklist Item: Avoid misuse of ARIA roles
Comments: Custom Tabs and CopyReviewKspTabs implement role=tablist without arrow-key roving tabindex, aria-controls, or tab ids. ImageCarousel uses tablist for thumbnails.

Checklist Item: ARIA used only when necessary
Comments: Hand-rolled Tabs/KspTabs/ImageCarousel tablists instead of Spectrum Tabs where a tab pattern is needed.

Checklist Item: Meta tags do not block zoom
Comments: Viewport does not set maximum-scale or user-scalable=no.

Checklist Item: No broken links (run broken-link-checker or linkinator CLI against local build or source HTML)
Comments: No linkinator/broken-link-checker script. HashRouter routes and Experience Cloud URL are not scanned.

Checklist Item: CSS variables used for all colors
Comments: Spectrum style macro tokens are used, but hardcoded hex remains (#e86a00, #606060, #1a1a1a, #f5f9ff, ApprovalReviewersPanel.css #6d6d6d).

Checklist Item: CSS variables used for spacing scale
Comments: Style-macro numeric spacing coexists with raw px in inline styles (padding: 8px 12px, height: 288, gap: 32).

Checklist Item: CSS variables used for typography scale
Comments: PageHeader uses font heading tokens, but EditRegenPanel and TemplatePreview set fontSize/fontWeight/color via UNSAFE_style and inline CSS.

Checklist Item: No hardcoded hex/rgb color values
Comments: Hardcoded hex/rgb in GenerateAsset previewBg, ProductDetails, TemplatePreview, Stepper, ApprovalReviewersPanel.css, projectHubBanner.

Checklist Item: No hardcoded pixel spacing where tokens exist
Comments: Inline pixel spacing is widespread (width: 64, height: 56, paddingTop: 7) instead of the S2 4px token scale via the style macro.

Checklist Item: Consistent naming conventions
Comments: Component files follow kebab/camel project conventions (PageHeader, *.styles.ts). Spectrum style() keys are consistent.

Checklist Item: Class names do not contain hex values or color names as identifiers; no purely positional names (left1/col2); BEM or project naming convention pattern enforced
Comments: No class names embedding hex or purely positional left1/col2 identifiers in first-party CSS modules.

Checklist Item: CSS selectors for same component co-located in same file; no duplicate selectors scattered across files; related rules grouped by component
Comments: Per-component *.styles.ts colocates selectors (CopyReview, GenerateAsset, AgentPanel). Shared approval CSS is next to the component.

Checklist Item: Layout containers use display:flex or display:grid; no float:left/right for multi-column layouts; no display:table for non-tabular content; absolute positioning in <5% of layout containers
Comments: Layouts use flex/grid via the S2 style macro. No float:left/right or display:table for multi-column layout in app/.

Checklist Item: min-width media queries outnumber max-width queries; base styles (outside media queries) target mobile viewport dimensions
Comments: Almost no component-level min-width media queries. Style-macro breakpoints are rarely used; layouts are desktop-fixed with inline widths (280, 200).

Checklist Item: Standard breakpoints only
Comments: When breakpoints appear they come from the S2 style macro scale (xs-2xl). No ad-hoc 680/925px queries in app/.

Checklist Item: Responsive images by default
Comments: No srcset/sizes. loading=lazy on some cards only. Single src URLs for product and mock assets.

Checklist Item: Avoid z-index escalation
Comments: z-index values are small (1, 10, 50). No 9999 escalation.

Checklist Item: Avoid expensive box-shadows
Comments: Multi-layer box-shadows on EditRegenPanel, ImageReplacePanel, MainLayout footer (3-layer rgba shadows).

Checklist Item: Avoid heavy CSS filters
Comments: No large blur() filters. ImageCarousel uses brightness/invert on nav glyphs only.

Checklist Item: No infinite CSS animations on non-loading elements; animation duration under 1s; total animation count per page within threshold
Comments: No infinite CSS animations on chrome. Looping <video> is confined to generating/regenerating loading dialogs (aria-hidden).

Checklist Item: All CSS properties/values supported in target browsers (checked against caniuse compatibility data); no unprefixed experimental features without fallbacks
Comments: No caniuse/compat baseline in repo. S2 targets evergreen browsers; no documented fallbacks for experimental CSS.

Checklist Item: Avoid vendor prefixes unless required
Comments: No legacy -webkit-box prefixes in first-party app CSS/style files.

Checklist Item: No duplicated CSS rules
Comments: Repeated inline flex-column/gap stacks duplicated across ReviewApprove, GenerateAsset, EditRegenPanel instead of shared layout styles.

Checklist Item: No unused CSS selectors
Comments: No unused-CSS analysis (PurgeCSS/coverage). CSS modules plus many one-off inline rules are not proven unused-free.

Checklist Item: Consistent property ordering
Comments: No stylelint-order or declaration-order plugin. Root eslint config does not lint app CSS/TS.

Checklist Item: No blocking scripts in head
Comments: No classic blocking scripts in <head>. App entry is type=module at end of body.

Checklist Item: Use async or defer appropriately
Comments: Inline IIFE in index.html injects an _mr script without async/defer when the query param is present.

Comments: No GTM/marketing tags in head. Only the Parcel module entry and optional local _mr helper.

Checklist Item: No JS files loaded on pages where their exports are unused; code-split bundles match route usage
Comments: Single Parcel HashRouter bundle; all workflow routes imported from App.tsx with no route-level code splitting.

Checklist Item: No marketing tags in head
Comments: No marketing tag manager snippets in index.html.

Checklist Item: User-facing strings in component render/template functions reference i18n keys or constants; hardcoded display strings >3 words flagged
Comments: User-facing copy is hardcoded English in JSX and LABEL constants. No i18n library or message catalogs.

Checklist Item: No binaries stored in repository
Comments: No compiled binaries (.exe/.dll/.so/.wasm/.jar) under app/. Assets are png/jpg/svg/webm.

Checklist Item: Error messages follow consistent pattern (checked via regex); no raw string throws; error constants or error classes used
Comments: Throws are raw throw new Error('...') strings in callAction, finalizeDownload, index.tsx. No shared error class/constants.

Checklist Item: Avoid tight DOM coupling
Comments: No querySelector/getElementById coupling in components. React refs used for file input and layout slots.

Checklist Item: Avoid forced synchronous layouts
Comments: No getBoundingClientRect/offsetHeight/offsetWidth reads in app/src.

Checklist Item: All setTimeout/setInterval calls have corresponding clear calls; timer count per file within threshold (max 3); no timers <100ms
Comments: setTimeout without matching clear in EditRegenPanel, SmartBriefGeneratingDialog onComplete (300ms), CopyRegeneratingDialog (400ms). AuthContext does clear.

Checklist Item: setInterval for DOM/state checks flagged (suggest MutationObserver/IntersectionObserver/EventListener); polling intervals <1s flagged
Comments: setInterval used for progress/state simulation (useCopyProgressTick 3000ms, useJobMockProgress, useMockProgress, generation streams store, dialogs). React Query also polls at 3s/10s.

Checklist Item: Prefer native browser APIs
Comments: First-party code uses fetch, AbortController, ES modules, React. No jQuery.

Checklist Item: Modern ES6+ syntax used
Comments: TypeScript ES2022, import/export, async/await, const/let throughout app/src.

Checklist Item: Avoid memory leaks
Comments: Module-level mutable listeners and simulationIntervalId in AuthContext and useGenerationStreamsStore can outlive components if cleanup is skipped.

Checklist Item: Event listeners cleaned up properly
Comments: React useEffect cleanups abort fetch and clear intervals in pollers/progress hooks. No raw addEventListener in app/src.

Checklist Item: Async logic uses async/await
Comments: Async flows use async/await in services/hooks. Promise.catch used for Foundry start abort.

Checklist Item: Promises handled correctly
Comments: Foundry start handles AbortError and FAILED status. callAction checks res.ok and throws. Query mutations log errors.

Checklist Item: State changes occur through defined setters/reducers/actions; no direct state object property mutations outside state management layer
Comments: UI state goes through Zustand stores and React setState. No ad-hoc window.* product state.

Checklist Item: No mutation of shared state
Comments: Shared state is in Zustand stores with named setters rather than mutating exported objects.

Checklist Item: No side effects in pure functions
Comments: mergeSmartBrief logs and returns mock data as a side effect of a merge helper (console.log plus mock fallback).

Checklist Item: Consistent return types
Comments: TypeScript strict mode is on; public helpers have explicit return types in sampled modules.

Checklist Item: No global variables
Comments: AuthContext keeps _shellDetected, _latestConfig, and _configListeners as module-level globals outside React state.

Checklist Item: JS scoped to component or block
Comments: UI logic lives in page/component/hook modules. No window.decorate/block globals.

Checklist Item: Consistent coding style
Comments: Root eslint ignores app (--ignore-pattern app). No Prettier/stylelint on the UI. app/tsconfig is strict but unused by npm lint.

Checklist Item: Avoid deeply nested callbacks
Comments: No Promise.then pyramids. Async uses await; callbacks are event handlers and map iterators.

Checklist Item: Call chain depth <=4 levels; wrapper functions that only delegate flagged; files with >80% re-exports flagged
Comments: No eslint complexity/max-depth rule and no script measuring call-chain or re-export-only files.

Checklist Item: All external inputs are validated, sanitized, and securely handled to prevent errors, misuse, and security vulnerabilities
Comments: User text (prompts, comments, chat, package names) is not sanitized. FileUpload chunks files but does not validate content types beyond UI.

Checklist Item: No unreachable code
Comments: TypeScript + no unused-disable of unreachable. No obvious dead branches in sampled modules.

Checklist Item: No empty catch blocks
Comments: GenerationBackgroundSync catch handles AbortError and FAILED; not empty. No empty catch {} found.

Checklist Item: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance met
Comments: No axe/jest-axe/Lighthouse CI. Custom tabs, unlabeled chat input, heading-as-Text, and empty product alts mean AA cannot be claimed.

Checklist Item: Announce dynamic content changes
Comments: ProgressBars have aria-label but generation/copy completion is not announced via aria-live. Agent FAB has a name but no live region for replies.

Checklist Item: Modal/dialog elements have role='dialog' or role='alertdialog' with aria-modal='true' and aria-labelledby/aria-label; keydown handler for Escape key present in source; focusable elements exist inside dialog container
Comments: Spectrum CustomDialog is used, but ReviewApprove and VariantImagesDialog omit aria-label/aria-labelledby on the dialog. Others set aria-label.

Checklist Item: <video> elements have <track kind='captions'> with valid non-empty src
Comments: The only video is a decorative looping loader with aria-hidden=true; captions are not applicable.

Checklist Item: <audio> elements have adjacent transcript link or aria-describedby pointing to transcript content; transcript container visible (not display:none/visibility:hidden)
Comments: No audio elements in app/src.

Checklist Item: No focus-trap calls outside of modal/dialog components; no keydown handlers that programmatically restrict Tab key to a subset of elements on non-modal pages
Comments: No custom Tab-key traps on non-modal pages. Focus trapping is left to Spectrum Dialog/CustomDialog.

Checklist Item: Visible focus styles present
Comments: EditRegenPanel textarea sets outline:none with no :focus-visible replacement. Custom native buttons (tabs, FAB, FormatCard) rely on UA/browser defaults, not a documented focus ring.

Checklist Item: All CSS :hover rules have corresponding :focus or :focus-visible rules on the same selectors
Comments: No CSS :hover rules in app/, so no paired :focus-visible equivalents for custom interactive chrome (tabs, suggestion chips, carousel nav).

Checklist Item: Visually-hidden patterns (.sr-only/.visually-hidden) use approved clip/position technique; no display:none or visibility:hidden on screen-reader-targeted text
Comments: No .sr-only/.visually-hidden using display:none. Screen-reader names use aria-label on controls.

Checklist Item: No eval() or Function(string) usage
Comments: No eval() or new Function() in app/src.

Checklist Item: No document.write or document.writeln
Comments: No document.write/writeln in app/src.

Checklist Item: External scripts use Subresource Integrity (SRI) where applicable
Comments: External Experience Cloud link and dynamic _mr script have no integrity/crossorigin SRI.

Checklist Item: No unsanitized user input in innerHTML or dangerous sinks
Comments: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML or innerHTML sinks in app/src.

Checklist Item: No hardcoded API keys or secrets in source
Comments: IMS token comes from Experience Cloud runtime config, not hardcoded keys. ALLOWED_IMS_ORG is env. No sk-/AIza/BEGIN KEY matches.

Checklist Item: No credentials or tokens in URLs or query parameters
Comments: Bearer token is sent in Authorization headers (withAuthHeaders/useActionCall), not query strings. localDevUrl is a launch URL, not a secret.

Checklist Item: No sensitive data in client-side comments or console logs
Comments: console.log of Smart Brief / Generate Prompt payloads and mergeSmartBrief mock fallback can leak workflow identifiers in the browser console.

Checklist Item: No insecure storage usage (localStorage/sessionStorage/Cookies or other browser storage for secrets)
Comments: No localStorage/sessionStorage/document.cookie usage in app/src. IMS session stays in memory.

Checklist Item: No PII stored in cookies or browser storage without encryption or consent
Comments: No PII written to cookies or Web Storage. Auth email/name stay in React context from the shell.

Checklist Item: No known vulnerable dependencies (npm audit / Snyk)
Comments: npm audit reports 17 vulnerabilities (9 high, 7 moderate, 1 low) in the workspace lockfile.

Checklist Item: No sensitive data exposed in client-visible IDs or data attributes
Comments: No tokens/passwords in data-* attributes. Dataset usage is not present for secrets.

Checklist Item: Zero lint errors (ESLint/Stylelint)
Comments: npm run lint uses --ignore-pattern app, so the UI is not in the ESLint corpus. Zero-error claim cannot be made for app/.

Checklist Item: No unused variables
Comments: ESLint is not run on app/. TypeScript strict helps but unused locals are not proven by lint.

Checklist Item: No unused functions
Comments: No ts-prune/unused-exports tooling. Dead helpers in large pages are not gated.

Checklist Item: No unused imports
Comments: ESLint unused-imports is not applied to app/. TS may catch some, but the checklist requires static unused-import detection.

Checklist Item: No dead code paths
Comments: No no-unreachable findings; sampled control flow does not leave dead returns.

Checklist Item: No dead code files (unreferenced modules)
Comments: No depcheck. Root dependencies such as uuid, cloudevents, core-js, regenerator-runtime, @spectrum-icons/workflow have no imports under app/src.

Checklist Item: No commented-out production code
Comments: Multi-line commented-out production UI remains in EditRegenPanel (reference-image TagGroup and browse dropzone).

Checklist Item: No implicit globals
Comments: ES modules + TypeScript; no implicit undeclared globals. window.location.origin is an explicit API.

Checklist Item: Consistent file structure
Comments: app/src is organized as pages, components, hooks, store, services, layouts, constants, data.

Checklist Item: No duplicated constants
Comments: Repeated Select All / progress / card-layout patterns and mock product names (HP - ZBook 14) appear in multiple modules instead of one constant source.

Checklist Item: Variable names >2 characters (excluding loop iterators i/j/k/x/y); no single-letter variables outside loops; no anti-pattern names (temp/tmp/data/val/stuff/thing/foo/bar without qualifier); camelCase or snake_case consistent per file
Comments: Single-letter identifiers outside loop iterators: TemplatePreview const s, AgentPanel map (s, i), GenerateAsset/ReviewApprove map i.

Checklist Item: Function names start with verb (get/set/is/has/should/create/update/delete/handle/render/fetch/parse/validate/transform/format/check/find/load/save/remove/add/init/build/compute/on); names >4 characters; no generic names (doStuff/handleIt/process/run without descriptive suffix)
Comments: Hooks/services use verb names (useGenerateSmartBrief, getSmartBriefResult, handleSelect). React components are noun-named per convention.

Checklist Item: Consistent naming conventions
Comments: camelCase TS/React naming is consistent. File names match exports.

Checklist Item: No nested ternary expressions beyond 1 level; no if/else chains >4 branches (suggest switch/object-map); boolean expressions <=3 conditions per statement; complex boolean expressions without intermediate named variable flagged
Comments: No nested ternaries beyond one level found in sampled pages. Complex flags are named (allSelected, isControlled).

Checklist Item: Functions with if-block wrapping >80% of function body flagged for guard-clause inversion; nested if-else >3 levels deep where outermost condition is validation/type-check flagged for early return
Comments: No lint rule for guard-clause inversion or nested validation depth.

Checklist Item: Average file size under 500 LOC; functions under 40 lines; module boundaries well-defined
Comments: Several files exceed 400 LOC (ReviewApprove 472, ProductDetails 421, mockCopyReview 398). Average is under 500 but oversized page modules remain.

Checklist Item: Files have single responsibility and clear module boundaries
Comments: ReviewApprove, ProductDetails, and NPIWorkflow mix data, layout, dialogs, and selection state in one module.

Checklist Item: README present
Comments: Root README.md documents the mAIstro UX workstream and app/ location.

Checklist Item: Consistent error handling strategy
Comments: Errors mix throw new Error, console.warn in mutations, silent FAILED job status, and merge-to-mock fallbacks. No shared taxonomy.

Checklist Item: Errors logged meaningfully
Comments: Mutation/poller failures use console.warn with a tagged prefix ([Smart Brief triggered], [Fusion Smart Brief Copy]).

Checklist Item: Errors fail gracefully
Comments: Auth screens and Loader cover missing IMS/org. Failed Foundry jobs set FAILED rather than crashing the tree. ErrorBoundary is a dependency.

Checklist Item: Avoid magic numbers
Comments: Magic numbers: SHELL_TIMEOUT_MS 5000 is named, but 280/200 sidebar widths, 288 card height, 300/600 preview, 3s poll, 400ms complete delay are inline.

Checklist Item: Constants centralized
Comments: Some labels live in constants/* but many strings and timeouts remain inlined in components.

Checklist Item: Config-driven behavior
Comments: Action URLs come from config.json via callAction. ALLOWED_IMS_ORG from process.env. Fusion/Foundry helpers take runtime IMS.

Checklist Item: Shared utilities extracted
Comments: Shared helpers exist (callAction, withAuthHeaders, generationJob, copyReviewState, mergeSmartBrief).

Checklist Item: Duplicate code percentage within standard threshold
Comments: No jscpd/Sonar duplication report. Card/dialog/toolbar patterns are repeated across ReviewApprove, SelectOutput, ConfigurePackage.

Checklist Item: No hardcoded environment values
Comments: Hardcoded https://experience.adobe.com/?devMode=true#/custom-apps/ launch URL in App.tsx. Mock UUIDs in DEFAULT_COPY_CONTEXT.

Checklist Item: Avoid circular dependencies
Comments: No circular import evidence in the TS graph (pages -> components/hooks/store; AuthContext isolated). madge not required to confirm obvious layering.

Checklist Item: No stale TODO/FIXME comments; no comments referencing symbols that do not exist in scope; no commented-out code blocks
Comments: No TODO/FIXME comments under app/src.

Checklist Item: commented-out code blocks >3 lines flagged; TODO/FIXME without issue-tracker reference flagged;
Comments: EditRegenPanel contains a commented-out production block longer than 3 lines (reference image + browse UI).

Comments: html lang=en is a valid BCP 47 tag matching the English UI.
